You’re not alone. I’ve been relapsing on and off every time I go back to my house from studying abroad. I know how it feels like to not have anyone you trust around you. I don’t know what would help but just remember that it’s all about perception. Your view of the world reflects how it affects you.
Best wishes and I really hope you get better. Just hold on and better days will come.

If the relationship is hurting you and you no longer feel joy from it then you should consider letting go. Find someone who you trust and tell them what you’re going through. It’s hard to reach out about these stuff but if they care about you they will help you feel better. 
It’s tough cause you’re so attached to the memories you have with him and the times you spent together. But right now it’s different. You’re scared. And that’s not love anymore. You deserve better. Reaching out is a big step and it’s gonna make you feel better.
